#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    int ans = 0;
    int i = 0;
    int len = line.length();
    while (i < len) {
        int j = i;
        char current = line[i];
        while (j < len && line[j] == current) {
            j++;
        }
        if ((j - i) % 2 == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
